title: Code Impact Analyst
subtitle: For every function or type a change touches, it lists what calls it and what it calls up to three steps out.
lede: For every function or type a change touches, it lists what calls it and what it calls up to three steps out. It counts how many files and packages are affected and sorts the change into security, concurrency, data-schema or routine risk from the paths involved, so the reviewer knows how hard to look.
who: An engineering manager or reviewer who wants to know what a change will touch before it is made
author: Corey James
